description: South Korea's pollutant release and transfer register for chemicals. The PRTR site menu, read on the Korean home page, covers the survey system (purpose, legal basis, procedure, target industries and target substances), release and transfer information with integrated search and views by year, by region, by substance, by industry and by company, publications including release estimation guides, survey result reports and reduction technology guides, the 30/50 programme results, and a data room with an Open API and a substance search. It is free to use online. Coverage is South Korea at company and facility level. Caveats: the English pages did not load from the cloud session, and the licence, years covered and API terms are not stated on the page read. For simulation it locates chemical-handling facilities with their releases, which supports exposure mapping and consequence modelling around industrial complexes. A related catalogue record is the EU Industrial Emissions Portal.
